editorial:
Imagine waking up in the year 2066 only to find out that giant raptors have taken over the entire world. You are thrown right into the middle of this chaos with a squad of tough marines who are the last line of defense for humanity. The vibe is basically a wild mix of a war movie and a monster flick. You get to see these soldiers try to survive in a world where they are no longer the top of the food chain, and the tension stays high as they fight through raptor-infested territory just to keep the human race alive.

What really works here is the fast pacing and the way the action scenes keep you on your toes. While some of the special effects might look a bit dated, the sheer excitement of the raptor attacks makes up for it. It is a great pick if you just want to turn your brain off and watch something loud and fun.
endingExplained: In the final act, the marines lead a desperate charge to destroy the raptor nesting grounds. You see a huge battle where the soldiers use every weapon they have to take down the alpha raptor. Once the leader is killed, the rest of the pack falls into chaos. The movie ends with the survivors looking out over the landscape, knowing they have bought humanity enough time to rebuild and fight back.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dinosaur movies and military action.
